title: Balancing Privacy, Utility, and Safety in LLM Alignment through Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.30141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preference optimization is widely used to align large language models with human preferences, but preference-data composition may also influence privacy-relevant memorization. We examine whether adding synthetic privacy-preference pairs to Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is associated with lower canary-based memorization signals without modifying the objective or introducing a formal privacy mechanism. We propose Privacy-Pressure Preference Mixing (P3M), a data-composition protocol that varies the amount of privacy-preference data while keeping helpfulness and harmlessness preference data fixed. We evaluate a non-privacy Baseline and privacy-mixing ratios of 0.5, 1.0, and 2.0 using Gemma 3 270M-IT across five random seeds and validate the same four conditions using 4-bit-quantized Gemma 2 2B-IT across three seeds. Overall, under the tested conditions, privacy-preference mixing is associated with lower mean canary suffix log-likeli

translated_title: 通过偏好优化在大语言模型对齐中平衡隐私、效用与安全性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.30141v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：偏好优化被广泛用于使大语言模型与人类偏好对齐，但偏好数据的组成也可能影响与隐私相关的记忆化现象。我们研究了在不修改目标函数或引入正式隐私机制的情况下，向直接偏好优化（DPO）中添加合成的隐私偏好对，是否与更低的基于金丝雀（canary）的记忆化信号相关。我们提出了隐私压力偏好混合，这是一种数据组成协议，它在保持有用性和无害性偏好数据固定不变的同时，改变隐私偏好数据的数量。我们使用 Gemma 3 270M-IT 在五个随机种子下评估了非隐私基线以及 0.5、1.0 和 2.0 的隐私混合比例，并使用 4 比特量化的 Gemma 2 2B-IT 在三个种子下验证了相同的四个条件。总体而言，在所测试的条件下，隐私偏好混合与更低的平均金丝雀后缀对数似然相关……
tldr: 提出P3M数据组成协议，通过在DPO训练数据中混入合成隐私偏好对，在不修改训练目标的情况下降低大语言模型的隐私记忆化信号。
en_tdlr: Proposes P3M, a data-composition protocol that mixes synthetic privacy-preference pairs into DPO training data to reduce canary-based memorization in LLMs without modifying the training objective.
